channel.title: Pier & Point · William J. Rutter Center
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for William J. Rutter Center (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · William J. Rutter Center: The shape's note now names the mapping log in words instead…
item.description: The shape's note now names the mapping log in words instead of printing a web address. No change to the shape, status or use. Source: Pier & Point's own text edit.

item.title: Correction · William J. Rutter Center: The Rutter Center page now says its 2005 date is the…
item.description: The Rutter Center page now says its 2005 date is the project year on the architect's page, not a stated completion or opening date. Sources give three, four and five stories. Source: Legorreta Arquitectos, UCSF Community Center project page (legorreta.mx); Forell/Elsesser, William J. Rutter Center project page (forell.com); OpenStreetMap way 84812339 (api.openstreetmap.org, read 2026-10-12).

item.title: Correction · William J. Rutter Center: The record and its map notes had named the 'Bakar Fitness &…
item.description: The record and its map notes had named the 'Bakar Fitness & Recreation Center' and 'Mission Bay Conference Center' and called the style Mexican-modernist; none of the cited pages says so, so they now list the uses the sources give. Stories are shown as five (Forell) or four (Legorreta) and size as 150,000 to 156,615 sq ft, the opening is the year 2005 only, the 2000 Regents item is described as a recommendation with the March 2000 budget approval it recounts, and the name is now 'William J. Rutter Center' as OpenStreetMap and Forell give it. The 2008 photo's capture year and the '1625 Owens St' address are no longer stated as fact, and the aerial photo caption no longer says 'from a departing flight'. Source: Legorreta Arquitectos, UCSF Community Center (https://www.legorreta.mx/en/proyecto-centro-comunitario-campus-mission-bay-ucsf); Forell/Elsesser Engineers, UCSF Mission Bay William J. Rutter Center (https://forell.com/projects/ucsf-mission-bay-william-j-rutter-center); OpenStreetMap way 84812339 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/84812339); UC Regents item, 2000-05 (https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/may00/101d.pdf); UC Regents presentation, 2008-09 (https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/sept08/j1pp.pdf).

Rutter Center (https://forell.com/projects/ucsf-mission-bay-william-j-rutter-center); OpenStreetMap way 84812339 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/84812339); UC Regents item, 2000-05 (https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/may00/101d.pdf); UC Regents presentation, 2008-09 (https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/sept08/j1pp.pdf)

item.title: Added · William J. Rutter Center: The March 2000 UC Regents item approves a $58M project budget…
item.description: The March 2000 UC Regents item approves a $58M project budget for Mission Bay Building 21B, identified as the Rutter Community Center by matching size and program. Source: UC Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings, Item 101D: Approval of Design, Mission Bay Campus Community Center Building (21B), 2000-05-17 (https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/may00/101d.pdf).
item.source: UC Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings, Item 101D: Approval of Design, Mission Bay Campus Community Center Building (21B), 2000-05-17 (https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/may00/101d.pdf)

item.title: Complete · William J. Rutter Center: William J. Rutter Center (UCSF Community Center)… (~2005)
item.description: William J. Rutter Center (UCSF Community Center) shown as complete in 2005: Legorreta Arquitectos' project page lists 'Year: 2005' as the project year without saying whether that is completion or opening, and the May 2000 Regents item expected completion in 2002; the actual completion or opening date and month are not sourced (~2005). Source: Legorreta Arquitectos (architect, own material).

item.title: Complete · William J. Rutter Center: William J. Rutter Center (UCSF Community Center)… (~2005)
item.description: William J. Rutter Center (UCSF Community Center) completed: Legorreta Arquitectos' project page lists the year 2005; the opening month is not sourced (~2005). Source: https://www.legorreta.mx/en/proyecto-centro-comunitario-campus-mission-bay-ucsf ; https://forell.com/projects/ucsf-mission-bay-william-j-rutter-center.

item.title: Planned · William J. Rutter Center: UC Regents item for the Committee on Grounds and… (May 2000)
item.description: UC Regents item for the Committee on Grounds and Buildings (May 2000) recommends certifying an EIR addendum and approving the design of the Mission Bay Campus Community Center Building (21B) – this building, confirmed by matching architects (MBT Architecture as executive architect with Legorreta Arquitectos as design subconsultant) and program (fitness/recreation center, conference center, food service, retail); the item recounts that the Regents approved a $58,000,000 total project cost in March 2000 and states construction 'will begin in 2001 and be completed in 2002'. The item is the recommendation; the committee's action itself is not shown (May 2000). Source: The Regents of the University of California, 2000-05.
item.source: The Regents of the University of California, 2000-05
